replacement.title: Proposal Narrative and Section Content Integration
replacement.definition: Include and integrate all required narrative sections and subsections supplied for the GreenLatinos RFQ response.

patches.decision_note: Content completeness evolves independently from visual layout: full-document assembly is requested, a missing section creates material uncertainty, and the client later supplies an omitted subsection for inclusion.

value_updates.layout_and_formatting: Apply layout and formatting to the RFQ response.

patches.decision_note: Document-content assembly belongs to the independent narrative-integration Requirement; this Event should establish only layout and formatting.
The same Canva link was already delivered and concretely verified as editable; reusing it for v2 adds no distinct source-access transition.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer attached and delivered the first proposal draft before the accepted early-Wednesday draft deadline.

patches.decision_note: The source reports actual draft delivery, providing executed schedule evidence rather than merely claiming planned work is complete.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer attached and delivered proposal v2 during the agreed final-revision window.

patches.decision_note: Delivery of the revised artifact is concrete execution evidence for the final-revision schedule, not only an implementation claim.
